title: Upconversion nanoplatform unlocks the theranostic potential of Lu-177 radiotherapy via c-MET axis targeting in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) convert tissue-penetrating near-infrared photons into sharp visible emissions, offering background-free optical readouts for deep-tissue imaging. Here we report multilayer NaLuF:Yb,Tm@NaLuFUCNPs that simultaneously act as fluorescent probes and radioisotope precursors. Under 980 nm excitation, the particles generate...
